policy: GET environment0 remains incompatible with production and is never converted to1 or used to establish production access or candidate absence.

Production preflight uses the documented HEAD on the pinned production SEFIN host with protected own A1 and locally matched issuer CNPJ. Only an empty HEAD200/404 with absent/JSON content type is recognized; HTML, bodies, redirects, other statuses or unsupported contracts block.

HEAD transport accepts only the exact DPS identifier path with42 decimal digits after DPS. Query strings, bodies, unrelated paths, other hosts, credentials in URLs, weak TLS and redirects remain rejected.

The worker renews own mTLS transport before reserving a number, then HEAD-checks the exact reserved identifier before its single POST. HEAD200 blocks occupied identity; a documented empty HEAD404 permits preparing the original production XML. No automatic counter skipping or retransmission.

HEAD is transport/existence evidence, not fiscal eligibility or authorization. Production XML, POST response environment, complete original DPS binding, fiscal status, XSD and cryptographic document proof remain mandatory.

The unavailable DANFSe contract remains a separate blocker. No readiness, real invoice or email is enabled merely by changing the lookup method. Existing operations, signed originals, source reservations and counters are not reset.
